Venomous.description: Producing potent defensive toxins used to coat blades or bite back.

features.name: Venomous Vishkanya
features.tldr: You can secrete mild poison to augment your unarmed strikes.

Serpentine.description: Endowed with incredible flexibility and silent footwork.

features.name: Serpentine Vishkanya
features.tldr: You gain bonuses to Stealth and squeeze through narrow spaces easily.
